name: code-review
_note: The full custody pipeline plus the mental-model phases, wired as engine phases: preflight fanout(4 cluster branches: adherence[spec-solves-issue||plan-implements-spec||code-implements-plan]->adherence-rollup, mm-compliance[gather->judge], consistency[docs||tests]->consistency-rollup, security[gather->judge]) -> join-preflight -> preflight-verdict -> overview(+risk) -> review fanout(5 dims; publish-review opens one [ai-review] issue per finding) -> join -> per-issue(DYNAMIC fanout, one leg per open [ai-review] issue: triage(fix-triage-agent) -> fix(edit/commit) -> honesty fanout[cryptohash||fixverify] -> join-honesty -> honesty-verdict) -> join-per-issue -> honesty-verdict -> post-fix fanout[context || mm-updater->mm-route(choice)->mm-decision] -> join -> mrp -> done. Each phase pairs the generic `evidence-present` form check with a deterministic per-phase verdict: preflight (a 4-cluster nested fanout joined under preflight-verdict, whose conclude-preflight runs a deterministic block-gaps/warn-extras rollup over the issue->spec->plan->code chain + mm-compliance, posts one consolidated comment, and halts via on_blocked:halt until /override), overview (schema + cohort-partition + a deterministic `conclude-overview` risk scorer porting score.js/diffusion.js that owns the authoritative band and halts only on a garbled/unknown run; the agent's risk_band is an advisory hint), the 5 review dims (schema + findings-anchored + publish-review; the fanout's params.status_note flags request-changes legs in the status header), and then a per-issue dynamic fanout runs, for each open [ai-review] issue, triage (fix-triage-agent, host-authoritatively pinned to the leg's issue; schema + conclude-triage), fix (edit/commit -- conclude-fix commits the diff to the PR head with rebase-retry and closes the issue), and honesty (a cryptohash proof-of-work that a real test ran AND a fixverify semi-formal fix certificate, ANDed per issue by conclude-honesty). The per-issue legs join under honesty-verdict, whose aggregate-honesty reducer HALTS the pipeline (on_blocked:halt, /override-able) if ANY issue's fix is dishonest; issue selection is host-authoritative and the verdict is tamper-evident (both fail closed; a nested-leg conclude hook runs so fix/triage actually commit+close). The post-fix fanout runs context (schema-valid only, advisory; as of engine 4.0.0 a flat fanout leg DOES run its conclude hook, so a `conclude` declared here would fire -- the node does not declare one yet) in PARALLEL with mm-updater (evidence-present + mm-questions-present; a gh-aw create-pull-request safe-output opens an [mm] PR when mm_changed; the mm-route choice then routes true->mm-decision (hold for a human /mm-answer) or false->done, with no default so an unroutable verdict halts); the join waits for both before mrp (schema + conclude-mrp + a deterministic acceptance_plan: engine inputs[] deliver prior-phase evidence, per-cohort bands are re-derived via the shared _risk_score, and the custody-shaped pack is emitted as the merge-readiness-pack artifact). Remaining simplification: review findings are opened as [ai-review] issues but not yet posted as inline PR comments. Agent workflows live in .github/workflows/.

route: did the updater open an [mm] PR?
states._note: BPMN Exclusive Gateway. Holds for a human iff the updater actually opened an [mm] PR. This condition used to live NOWHERE in the protocol: it was the engine's empty-DATA-gate auto-skip (advance.py) inferring the route from whether `questions` happened to be empty, guarded by the mm-questions-present check. Routing on the decision itself is the proposition we mean, so the bypass is structurally unreachable rather than merely guarded. No `default`: a missing/garbled mm_changed halts (recoverable via /override) instead of being guessed into an arm.
